question:
Select the option that rectifies the spelling error of the underlined word.

The historic __cathedrel__ stood as a symbol of faith and architectural marvel, drawing visitors from around the world.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cathedrel"** appears to be a misspelling of the correct word "cathedral".
 
• **Meaning of the given word:** The misspelled word “cathedrel” does not exist in standard English vocabulary. However, it is meant to refer to “cathedral,” which means a large and important church, often the principal church in a diocese, where a bishop resides. (Hindi: महागिरजाघर)
 
 
• **Example:** The historic cathedrel stood as a symbol of faith and architectural marvel. (Incorrect usage)
 
 
 
• **Correct word:** The correct spelling is "cathedral".
 
• **Meaning of "cathedral":** A cathedral is a large and significant Christian church that is often the seat of a bishop. (Hindi: महागिरजाघर)
 
 
• **Example:** The historic cathedral stood as a symbol of faith and architectural marvel. (Correct usage)
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct spelling of the word is "cathedral," and it aligns with Option 4.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: cathidrel** (Hindi: गलत वर्तनी): This is an incorrect spelling of the word "cathedral."

 
 
• **Example:** The cathidrel was admired by all. (Incorrect usage)
 
 
 
• **Option 2: cathedril** (Hindi: गलत वर्तनी): This is another incorrect variation of the word "cathedral."
 
 
• **Example:** The cathedril was a historic landmark. (Incorrect usage)
 
 
 
• **Option 3: cathidral** (Hindi: गलत वर्तनी): This is yet another misspelling of the word "cathedral."
 
 
• **Example:** The cathidral was an architectural masterpiece. (Incorrect usage)
